planets.name: TOI-6054 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-6054 with a 7.5-day year, found in 2024.

text.card: TOI-6054 b was found in 2024 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-6054. Its orbit and size follow Kroft et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
